### Lament for Saul and Jonathan
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lament-for-saul-and-jonathan
Passage: 2 Samuel 1:19
Points:
- David's genuine grief showed he bore no malice toward Saul and was Israel's rightful king.
- Scriptural lament shows that mourning the tragedy of death is appropriate and necessary for believers.
- David was pained that Israel's defeat would lead pagan Philistines to gloat against God.
- Jonathan's persistent covenant loyalty to David stands as a model of enduring brotherly love.
- Believers are urged to practice the same steadfast devotion toward their brothers and sisters in Christ.

### Day 40: 2 Samuel 1:1–27
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-40-2-samuel-1-127.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 1:19
Points:
- David rejected opportunistic ambition and grieved deeply rather than celebrating Saul's demise.
- In his song of lament, David chose to honor Saul despite years of jealous pursuit.
- Jonathan demonstrated exceptional, selfless devotion by championing David's kingship over his own royal inheritance.
- Grieving the sudden loss of an irreplaceable friend is a painful journey that requires time to heal.
